groups.title: BL-342: one shared, pure, military-capable predicate that laws and techs both read

requirements.requirement: BL-342 (item-spanning): a condition_set is a flat AND-list of atomic conditions that RESOLVES against the world - pure, deterministic, and true when empty. evaluate() reads a const world& and nothing else; no RNG, no clock, no cached mutable state; a measure that sums over an unordered container sums in ascending entity-id order.
requirements.result_metric: condition_set_harness C1a-c, C4a-d, C5a-c PASS (40/40 assertions); the same world evaluates identically twice and two structurally-identical worlds measure bit-identically

requirements.requirement: BL-342: every subject resolves against a hand-built world and reads the quantity it claims to read - research (per-corp), structure, stockpile, market, surplus, era.
requirements.result_metric: C2a-l PASS; research asserted per-corp rather than global
requirements.notes: era measures launchpad ownership because ERAS.md is designed-not-implemented - recorded as NR-113.

requirements.requirement: BL-342: a subject may be MILITARY (BL-094 design test at the foundation). Adding one must not require reshaping the type, and the claim is proven by an instance rather than asserted.
requirements.result_metric: C6a-e PASS: military_units and military_strength ship and resolve; a mixed economic-AND-military predicate evaluates

requirements.requirement: BL-342: comparator boundaries are EXACT on integral subjects rather than epsilon-fuzzy, and continuous subjects compare as floats.
requirements.result_metric: C3a-j PASS; llround on both sides for integral subjects, exact float comparison for continuous ones

groups.title: BL-343: one law, enacted, enforced at a settled seam, and visible where the player already looks

requirements.requirement: BL-343 (item-spanning, visual): an enacted extraction levy appears as its own LEVIES line in the budget surface, beside income / expenditure / maintenance / wages / interest - not folded into an existing flow. A law the player cannot see working is indistinguishable from an unimplemented one.
requirements.result_metric: corporation_dashboard.cpp Finance card draws 6 bars (was 5); balance_ledger.cpp gains a Laws section with the enact checkbox directly beneath the two policy-tier stubs
requirements.notes: Visual capture owed on Windows with the rest of the stale goldens; the flow-chart change is a bar-count change in one array, verified by inspection and by law_harness L2c (net() accounts the new line).

requirements.requirement: BL-343: the enforcement seam holds - a law is a MODIFIER OVER the market, never an OVERRIDE OF it. The levy applies where the flow is accounted (apply_budget), never where the price is resolved (clear_markets), so no other flow moves.
requirements.result_metric: L3a-e PASS: income, expenditure, maintenance and wages are all bit-identical with and without the levy, and the levy is its own line

requirements.requirement: BL-343: an un-enacted law changes nothing (bit-identically), an enacted levy costs exactly rate x units, and repeal restores the baseline exactly.
requirements.result_metric: L1a-c, L2a-c, L4a-b PASS; the shipped seed is un-enacted and D1 asserts a caller omitting `production` charges nothing (the pre-BL-343 arithmetic)
requirements.notes: This is why no existing economy harness needed to change.

requirements.requirement: BL-343: two identical worlds with the same enacted set produce identical balances - determinism across the new seam. Predicates are resolved once per law per corp per tick, before the money loop reads them.
requirements.result_metric: L5a-b PASS; econ_harness, econ_bankruptcy, econ_stability, data_creep_harness and world_determinism all unchanged and passing

requirements.requirement: BL-343: nothing in the law record or the effect dispatch assumes an ECONOMIC subject - the taxonomy must accept a military effect when there is one to add (BL-315). Build the seam so the answer can become yes; do not claim it already is.
requirements.result_metric: law_effect_kind is an open enum whose only branch point is a switch in evaluate_laws; the predicate is BL-342 condition_set, which already carries military subjects
requirements.notes: Honestly recorded: an extraction levy does NOT reach military outcomes today.

rows.requirement: Under the Corporation lens, hovering ONE tile of a corporation's holdings on this body highlights EVERY tile it holds there, and hovering ground held by nobody highlights nothing (hovered_structure_kind == 'none').
Under the Company lens the same holds for a background firm, resolved by corporation_component::is_background - a corporation's tiles are not a company's group and vice versa.

The hand-wired lens_through marker pivot is gone: the Corporation lens resolves its owner through the area resolver on BOTH built and unbuilt owned ground, where before it could only fire on a marker.

groups.title: BL-666 - a corporation and a company each reach their own destination
groups.promoted_from: backlog.json BL-666 (owner ledger destinations) - Sprint 23, UI visibility batch 2

rows.requirement: A Corporation-lens tile-group press opens the corporations table AIMED at that corporation - the row for the corporation under the pointer is the selected one, not the player's own books.
A Company-lens tile-group press opens a company surface naming that background firm. It is a declared placeholder and says so on its face; it is not the corporations table and not the Balance ledger.
The company surface is a column occupant like every other: close_all_panels closes it, any_panel_open reports it, and opening another ledger closes it.
Live click: open the built app, click a rival's ground under Corporation and a background firm's ground under Company, and confirm each lands on its own destination.
